subject: Maths
title: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50 and 100
description: Pupils should be taught to count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50 and 100; find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number.
teachingNotes: Use number lines, hundred squares, and bead strings. Address common misconception of losing track across decade and century boundaries.
prerequisites: Count in steps of 2, 3, and 5 from 0
Ten more and ten less to 100

subject: Maths
title: Understand unit and non-unit fractions with small denominators
description: Pupils should be taught to recognise, find and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators.
teachingNotes: Begin with concrete sharing of counters and paper folding before writing abstract notation. Reinforce denominator = parts whole is split into, numerator = how many parts we have.
prerequisites: Recognise and find 1/2, 1/4, 2/4 and 3/4 of shapes and quantities

subject: Science
title: Compare how things move on different surfaces and observe magnetic attraction
description: Pupils should be taught to compare how things move on different surfaces; notice that some forces need contact between two objects, but magnetic forces can act at a distance.
teachingNotes: Hands-on exploration with bar magnets, testing friction on carpet vs tile vs wood. Clarify that not all metals are magnetic (iron, steel vs aluminium).
prerequisites: Explore everyday materials and their properties
